concept.title: Beyond the Watchtower
concept.logline: On sunlit, melancholy Galreach, you slip past the watchers to recover the sun shards and restore the Watchtower.
concept.source_prompt: Dune Sea. desert dunes dune sand stealth Stealth infiltration
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Oasis Market and becomes the one who brings the Watchtower back to life.

key_locations.name: Oasis Market
key_locations.description: The start: palms and awnings around a spring.

key_locations.name: Date Palm Oasis
key_locations.description: Date Palm Oasis: a grove on the way out from Oasis Market.

key_locations.name: Scorpion Grotto
key_locations.description: Scorpion Grotto: a cave of Galreach, reached by the trail from Oasis Market.

key_locations.name: Buried Palace
key_locations.description: Buried Palace: a ruin of Galreach, reached by the trail from Oasis Market.

key_locations.name: Watchtower
key_locations.description: Watchtower: a tower of Galreach, reached by the trail from Oasis Market.

characters.name: Caravan Master Nadia
characters.description: Waits in Oasis Market and knows why the Watchtower fell silent.

characters.name: Odo the Guide
characters.description: Follows you from Oasis Market and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Sandglass Sentinel
characters.description: A sandglass sentinel that walks the same beat over and over. Learn the loop and slip past.

characters.name: Sandglass Sentinel 2
characters.description: A sandglass sentinel that walks the same beat over and over. Learn the loop and slip past.

characters.name: Oasis Warden
characters.description: A oasis warden that never leaves its post, but lunges at anyone who gets close.

characters.name: Sefa the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Galreach for anything shiny.

characters.name: Sand Hopper
characters.description: A harmless sand hopper that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Slip past the sentinels site by site
Plant the signal at the finale
hazards: Sandglass Sentinel patrolling a fixed loop

actions.value: On sunlit, melancholy Galreach, you slip past the watchers to recover the sun shards and restore the Watchtower.
Heavy sentinels guard every site and they hit hard. Keep your distance.
In the Date Palm Oasis. Unseen, for now.
In the Scorpion Grotto. Unseen, for now.
In the Buried Palace. Unseen, for now.
Spotted! Break line of sight and get clear.
Signal planted. You were never here.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Nadia
nodes.text: So you've come to Oasis Market at last. I am Caravan Master Nadia. On sunlit, melancholy Galreach, you slip past the watchers to recover the sun shards and restore the Watchtower.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Nadia
nodes.text: Back again. Oasis Market is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Nadia
nodes.text: Go to Date Palm Oasis, then Scorpion Grotto. Whatever still remembers Beyond the Watchtower is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Nadia
nodes.text: They say Oasis Market was built on what was left of an older place. Lonely, even then. Ask the stones and they won't argue.

choices.text: Tell me about Date Palm Oasis.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Nadia
nodes.text: Date Palm Oasis: Date Palm Oasis: a grove on the way out from Oasis Market.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Nadia
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Beyond the Watchtower back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Nadia
nodes.text: Scorpion Grotto: Scorpion Grotto: a cave of Galreach, reached by the trail from Oasis Market.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Guide
nodes.text: Odo the Guide circles your feet, then looks toward Scorpion Grotto as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Guide
nodes.text: Odo the Guide keeps close and glances back at Oasis Market.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Guide
nodes.text: It turns toward Scorpion Grotto. Scorpion Grotto: a cave of Galreach, reached by the trail from Oasis Market.

nodes.speaker: Sandglass Sentinel
nodes.text: Halt. Sandglass Sentinel, of the watch at Oasis Market. Keep to the paths out there.

nodes.speaker: Sandglass Sentinel
nodes.text: Still in one piece? Good. Keep it that way.

nodes.speaker: Sandglass Sentinel
nodes.text: Sandglass Sentinel patrolling a fixed loop. Worst near Date Palm Oasis.

nodes.speaker: Sandglass Sentinel 2
nodes.text: Halt. Sandglass Sentinel 2, of the watch at Oasis Market. Keep to the paths out there.

nodes.speaker: Sandglass Sentinel 2
nodes.text: Still in one piece? Good. Keep it that way.

nodes.speaker: Sandglass Sentinel 2
nodes.text: Sandglass Sentinel patrolling a fixed loop. Worst near Date Palm Oasis.

nodes.speaker: Oasis Warden
nodes.text: Halt. Oasis Warden, of the watch at Oasis Market. Keep to the paths out there.

nodes.speaker: Oasis Warden
nodes.text: Still in one piece? Good. Keep it that way.

nodes.speaker: Oasis Warden
nodes.text: Sandglass Sentinel patrolling a fixed loop. Worst near Date Palm Oasis.

nodes.speaker: Sefa the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Oasis Market. Sefa the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Sefa the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Beyond the Watchtower that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Sefa the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Buried Palace after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Sand Hopper
nodes.text: The sand hopper freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
